propositions: An author-facing repair surface is needed to retroactively link commits to a ticket via the `attach-commits` verb, exposed on CLI, library, and MCP.
The verb must validate all provided commit SHAs exist via git before recording any COMMITS event (all-or-nothing), rejecting the batch if any SHA is invalid.
A deterministic close-gate check must block closing if any linked commit's changed paths are not declared in file_impact or exempted by configured globs.
Merge commits are skipped in the close-gate check because they author no content changes of their own; source-(i) remote SHAs are skipped if unreachable, while source-(ii) local commits fail closed.
The close-gate file_impact comparison must union across the ticket and all transitive descendants to match the scope of commit discovery and avoid false-blocking parent tickets.
Path matching uses normalized repo-relative POSIX paths with directory prefix matching and **/‐aware glob semantics; substring matching and LLM are explicitly out of scope.
